caveats: The five-try limit was reached. Attempt 5 is the best complete sheet, with residual fine mottled rust/steel treatment and more than one broad foil reflection; not a flawless pass under strict 11b.1/6.
The timer is blank and green, but a central pixel sampled #05F812 rather than exact #00FF00. No recolouring or resaving was performed; letterer should cover the blank display.
Background corner samples are #DEE0E3, #DEE0E2, #DDDDE2, #DDDEE1 rather than exact #E9E9EC; faint variation retained under 27 October override.
The sheet contains independent enlarged detail studies, not a common scale. Stake is canonically 1 m; later panels must size props to bodies.
No people, wrists, scale silhouettes, labels or text drawn. All side assignments are recorded for later scenes.

rejects.reason: All seven props present; rejected under 11b.1/6 for granular all-over wear, rendered metal/lens facets and crumpled-foil mosaic; orange cloth has fabric texture. No rejected image used as a reference.

Cleaner food and foil, but lamp lens retains low-poly facets, lamp/cloth remain too mottled, ladle bowl has multiple specular polygons. Retrying simpler two-colour metal rendering. No rejected image used as reference.

Improved lamp lens and ladle bowl, but extensive granular scuffs/mottling cover the stake and link; foil again has many small facets. Broad hard cast shadows are larger than requested contact shadows.
Cleaner stake and phone but double-hexagon emblem has extra central facet; rag has woven texture and ragged fringe; foil has excess reflection facets. Fifth attempt improves these.
